itemeditor.special.entity.tags.help.leas: Attach to a fence block or an entity UUID. Eligibility and leash behavior still depend on the entity.
itemeditor.special.entity.tags.help.UUID: Advanced identity override, not an owner. Reusing one UUID can conflict with existing entities. Spawn-egg loading can ignore this override; leaving it unset is usually best.
itemeditor.special.entity.tags.help.ange: Absolute world-game-time deadline, not a duration after spawning. -1 disables persistent anger. Clear persistent anger also removes the target.
itemeditor.special.entity.tags.help.dama: Arrow base damage multiplier; actual damage also depends on speed and modifiers. This inherited field does not control trident hit damage.
itemeditor.special.entity.tags.help.Loot: 0 means no fixed seed. Nonzero values select a deterministic random seed.
itemeditor.special.entity.tags.help.Deat: 0 means no fixed seed. Nonzero values select a deterministic random seed.
itemeditor.special.entity.tags.help.Life: Firework elapsed time, not remaining lifetime.

itemeditor.special.entity.tags.help.life: Internal arrow despawn counter, not a remaining-lifetime setting.
itemeditor.special.entity.tags.help.next: -1: automatic scheduling. -2: waxed. Otherwise an absolute world-game-time deadline.
itemeditor.special.entity.tags.help.Drow: -1: conversion inactive. Otherwise a countdown in game ticks.
itemeditor.special.entity.tags.help.life: Omitted: no starvation timer. Expiry starts starvation damage; it is not immediate death.
